name: ALOHA Unleashed
summary: DeepMind scaled bimanual demonstration collection across a fleet of ALOHA 2 rigs and trained large transformer diffusion policies on tens of thousands of demonstrations per task family. The resulting policies handle deformables and high-precision dexterity, including tying shoelaces, hanging a shirt on a hanger and replacing a robot gear, that had resisted prior methods.
innovation: Mapped the data-scaling curve for bimanual dexterity: hard deformable tasks become tractable with enough demos.
Fleet-scale teleoperation infrastructure as the actual enabling technology.
matters: Set the empirical bar for what pure imitation achieves given industrial-scale data.
limits: Per-task data requirements are far beyond what most labs can collect.
lineage: ALOHA hardware plus diffusion policies at DeepMind data scale.
